title: Model usage ledger line
description: One line of <store>/models/<model file name>.jsonl (layer.ModelDir of the model id), the per-model usage ledger the harness profile and the rules are a pure function of. Events v1 wrote carry no engine and are read and listed but never judged under v2. Source: memory/curated/modelusage.go (ModelEvent, RecordModelLocked, the ModelKind and Outcome constants); written by memory/harness/code.go, memory/rules/v2.go and memory/hooks/detectors_v2.go.

outcome.description: ok, error, empty, shown, omitted or columns for a call or decode; empty for a pass, detect or detector pass.

stage.description: compaction under v2; observer, reflector or dropper for v1's worker passes.

ranHeld.description: Held definitions a pass ran with: kind/name@digest (layer.Definition.HeldID).

roots.description: A compaction pass's evidence roots (rules.UnitOf): 16 hex characters each, sorted, of the records citing its cut range that are not tool output.

harm.description: A compaction pass's harm signal (rules.HarmCounts summed); absent on passes recorded before the settlement rules.

turns.description: The assistant messages a compaction's cut range removed.

repo.description: A compaction pass's repository: the commonest frame.repoId of its records.

family.description: A compaction pass's task family: the commonest lower-cased path extension its records name.

ranWritten.description: The model's own written definitions a compaction ran with: kind/name@digest (layer.Definition.HeldID).
